Bihar BDO, policewoman arrested in wife's death probe

Police in Muzaffarpur, Bihar, have arrested Block Development Officer (BDO) Manoj Kumar in connection with the death of his wife, Amrita Kumari. Her brother alleged dowry demands and harassment. The investigation is also exploring an extramarital affair involving Kumar and a policewoman, identified as Sub-Inspector Annu Kumari, who has also been taken into custody. Authorities are examining phone records and other evidence to determine the circumstances of the wife's death.
